segments.subtask: The robot arm approaches the test tubes on the table.
The robot arm grasps the test tube with red pigment.
The robot arm lifts the test tube with red pigment.
The robot arm moves the test tube with red pigment towards the container.
The robot arm pours the red pigment into the container.
The robot arm places the test tube with red pigment back on the table.
The robot arm grasps the test tube with blue pigment.
The robot arm lifts the test tube with blue pigment.
The robot arm moves the test tube with blue pigment towards the container.
The robot arm pours the blue pigment into the container.
The robot arm places the test tube with blue pigment back on the table.
The robot arm moves away from the container.
